【标语】：Don't let your work go unnoticed. Get promoted!
【介绍】：Meridian is an open-source AI work journal that runs entirely on your device. Meridian automatically drafts your updates for your project management tools like Jira, ready to post once you approve them. Do the work. Let the remembering take care of itself. No cloud, no account. MIT-licensed, free.
